leads.general: Code, limits, classification, people and status.
leads.statements: Statements per language, with a live preview.
leads.editorial: The editorial, its visibility and its authors.
leads.data: The data package, checker settings and the test list.
leads.files: Images in the statement, the PDF statement and attached material.
leads.external: Judge this problem on a remote online judge instead of here.

indexLead: Open by code or search the list.
lookupHint: Paste a code to open the editor directly, without the list.

create.title: Create problem
create.lead: Without the right to add problems, the problem is sent as a suggestion for staff to review.

basics.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore (1 to 32 characters). Changing the code changes the address.
basics.name: Name
basics.nameHint: Up to 100 characters. Sent only when you edit it; per-language names live in the Statements tab.
basics.summaryHint: Shown in the problem list, up to 1000 characters.
basics.ogImageHint: Image address used when the problem link is shared; empty for none.

limits.partialHint: Score by the number of tests passed, not only when all pass.

visibility.feedbackHint: The checker's message for each test.

errors.code: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore, 1 to 32 characters.
errors.highTime: Over 5 seconds needs the “Set a high time limit” permission.
errors.types: At least one problem type is needed.

descriptions.basics: Code and name show in the problem list.
descriptions.limits: Apply to every language unless a language has its own limit below.
descriptions.classes: Used by the public filters and for which languages can submit.
descriptions.visibility: What contestants see after they submit.
descriptions.people: Who edits, tests and sees the problem.

people.title: People in charge
people.orgPrivateHint: Only members of the listed organizations see the problem.

status.title: Status
status.dateOffer: Set the publication date to now, so the problem lists as new?

readiness.title: This problem may not be ready to publish:
readiness.noCases: It has no test cases, so every submission fails to judge.
readiness.noCasePoints: Its test cases are worth 0 points, so nobody can score.

clone.title: Clone {code}
clone.hint: Copies the statements, translations and test data.

statements.imageHint: An uploaded image is inserted at the cursor.
statements.fullMarkupNote: This problem uses full markup: the preview uses the plain style because you lack the “Use unsanitised problem markup” permission.

errors.character: Do not use the character {character}; use a plain one instead.

editorial.publicHint: When off, only staff and the authors see it.
editorial.publishOnHint: The editorial opens to everyone at this time (when publishing is on).

archive.title: Data archive
archive.lead: The zip, init.yml and the files inside it.
archive.note: Archive files only name the tests; download through their own link, never shown inline.

feedback.title: The last init.yml could not be generated

checker.title: Checker and grader
checker.jsonHint: Leave empty when there are no arguments. Must be a JSON object.

cases.title: Test list
cases.hardLimit: The “{permission}” permission allows up to {max} tests; this account has the usual limit.
cases.legend: C: single test · S: open a scored group · E: close the group. A group's points are the whole group's.
cases.badJsonRows: Fix the invalid JSON in test {rows} before saving.
cases.overMax: Over the limit of {max} rows; saving will be refused. Remove tests or groups.

errors.fileName: A file name is at most 100 characters and holds no NUL character.
errors.generatorArgs: Generator arguments are at most 1000 characters.
errors.count: Must be a whole number, zero or more.
errors.argsTotal: All test arguments together are over 1 MiB; shorten them.

sources.title: Attached source files
sources.removeBody: The problem stops using this file until it is uploaded again.

image.title: Images in the statement
image.lead: Each upload returns an address to paste into the statement.

pdf.title: Statement PDF
pdf.lead: One PDF for the whole problem; a new upload replaces it.
